how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-blackrock-spire-02-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

E1.en: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion

E24.en: Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet

rows.quest:6502:obj:0: You must retrieve the ⟦E1⟧ from ⟦E2⟧. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:6502:details:0: It is a piece of the dragon; a scale - enchanted and transformed. Whole, it could have granted access to the beast's lair. Shattered, it is useless.
rows.quest:6502:details:1: It is possible to repair the item, but to do so would require the blood of a black dragon champion. There is one... He is known as ⟦E2⟧, ruler of the dragonspawn armies of ⟦E4⟧. Perhaps you have heard of him?
rows.quest:6502:details:2: Return with his blood, ⟦1⟧, and I shall enchant the fragment into something that will grant you access to ⟦E5⟧'s lair.
rows.quest:6502:progress:0: The flow of time does not stop or slow, ⟦2⟧. While my life is eternal, yours is not. Waste not the time that you have...
rows.quest:6502:completion:0: This amulet will grant you the access that you seek. The lair of ⟦E5⟧ can be found in ⟦E6⟧. As long as you hold the amulet, her wards cannot prevent you from entering.
rows.quest:6502:completion:1: The Blue Flight wishes you luck, ⟦3⟧.
rows.quest:6569:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to ⟦E3⟧ and collect 20 ⟦E8⟧ Eyes. Return to ⟦E9⟧ when the task is complete.
rows.quest:6569:details:0: So the ⟦4⟧ wishes to become one of the Black Flight, eh?
rows.quest:6569:details:1: The creation of the illusion you require is trivial, but the components required for the divination are quite difficult to obtain. The Warchief has entrusted you with this mission, so Myranda must assume you as capable.
rows.quest:6569:details:2: ⟦E7⟧ to the upper citadel of ⟦E3⟧ and slay enough of the black dragonspawn to fill up one of your packs with their eyes.
rows.quest:6569:details:3: Return to Myranda when you have gathered enough of the reagent.
rows.quest:6569:progress:0: The eyes of that which we wish to mimic are the most important ingredient of any illusion, ⟦5⟧.⟦6⟧⟦7⟧<Myranda points to a bag almost overflowing with eyeballs labeled 'Scarlet Crusade.'>⟦8⟧⟦9⟧<Myranda laughs.>
rows.quest:6569:completion:1: Oh yes, these will do nicely.
rows.quest:6569:completion:2: With these reagents, Myranda will create for you a medallion that will grant an illusion capable of fooling the black dragonflight's gatekeeper.
rows.quest:6602:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to ⟦E3⟧ and slay ⟦E2⟧. Gather his blood and return it to ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:6602:details:0: How would you feel about paying a visit to the General? No illusions, this time.
rows.quest:6602:details:1: Ceremony? A pretty word to describe the bloodletting that amuses the Black Dragonflight.
rows.quest:6602:details:2: All this amulet requires is the blood of ⟦E2⟧. Primitive security. There are other ways to receive the General's blood.
rows.quest:6602:details:3: Go to ⟦E3⟧ and kill Drakkisath. Return with his blood and I will activate the key to ⟦E5⟧'s lair.
rows.quest:6602:progress:0: I don't think I need to tell you that Drakkisath is not to be taken lightly.⟦11⟧⟦12⟧I let the thousands dead by his hand do the talking.
rows.quest:6602:completion:0: A victory that will be remembered for many years, ⟦13⟧. The ⟦E13⟧ will open ⟦E5⟧'s lair. Gather your allies and bring victory to the ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:7761:obj:0: That is one stupid orc. It would appear as if you need to find this brand and gain the Mark of Drakkisath in order to access the Orb of Command.
rows.quest:7761:obj:1: The letter indicates that ⟦E2⟧ guards the brand. Perhaps you should investigate.
rows.quest:7761:details:1: I hold very little faith in your ability to prevent outsiders from accessing the master's lair. In the very likely event of your death, this orb has its own failsafe built in to prevent outsiders from teleporting directly into Blackwing.
rows.quest:7761:details:2: Only those with the Mark of Drakkisath branded upon their hand may make use of this orb. Thankfully, Drakkisath is not nearly as incompetent as you, Quartermaster. He guards the brand himself!
rows.quest:7761:completion:0: You don't even flinch as the smoldering brand is pressed into your flesh. You are so tough!
rows.quest:7761:completion:1: You now hold the Mark of Drakkisath. Have fun storming the castle.
rows.quest:8966:obj:0: Use the ⟦E20⟧ to summon forth the spirit of ⟦E21⟧ and slay him. ⟦E22⟧ inside ⟦E23⟧ with the ⟦E24⟧ and the ⟦E20⟧.
rows.quest:8966:details:0: My friend, ⟦E21⟧, was the first to fall victim to possession of a piece of ⟦E25⟧'s amulet, and the corrupting spirit fragment that it contains. After stealing Valthalak's spellbook and amulet, we fled for our lives from the upper portion of ⟦E3⟧. Along the way, Mor fell into the lower portion of the spire.
rows.quest:8966:details:1: Later, we discovered that he survived the fall, only to be captured and tortured by ⟦E26⟧. A few spectral assassins snuck in and slew him right in front of ⟦E27⟧.
rows.quest:8966:progress:0: Then it is done? You have retrieved the left piece of ⟦E25⟧'s amulet and finally put to rest the spirit of my old companion, ⟦E21⟧?
rows.quest:8966:completion:0: You have done a great thing, ⟦14⟧. One spirit rests in peace, but there is still much work to be done before we can put all of this behind us.
rows.quest:8966:completion:1: Unfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not fear; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.
rows.quest:8989:obj:0: Use the ⟦E20⟧ to summon forth the spirit of ⟦E21⟧ and slay him. ⟦E22⟧ inside ⟦E23⟧ with the recombined ⟦E29⟧ and the ⟦E20⟧.
rows.quest:8989:details:0: My friend, ⟦E21⟧, was the first to fall victim to possession of a piece of ⟦E25⟧'s amulet, and the corrupting spirit fragment that it contains. After stealing Valthalak's spellbook and amulet, we fled for our lives from the upper portion of ⟦E3⟧. Along the way, Mor fell into the lower portion of the spire.
rows.quest:8989:details:1: Later, we discovered that he survived the fall, only to be captured and tortured by ⟦E26⟧. A few spectral assassins snuck in and slew him right in front of ⟦E27⟧.
rows.quest:8989:progress:0: Then it is done? You have retrieved the right piece of ⟦E25⟧'s amulet, recombined the amulet into one whole, and finally put to rest the spirit of my old companion, ⟦E21⟧?
rows.quest:8989:completion:0: Thank you for helping ⟦E21⟧, ⟦15⟧. Another spirit rests in peace, and we now have the reassembled amulet! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.
rows.quest:8989:completion:1: In order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth ⟦E25⟧, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.
rows.quest:8995:obj:0: Use the ⟦E20⟧ to summon ⟦E25⟧. Dispatch him, and use ⟦E29⟧ on the corpse. Then, return ⟦E29⟧ to the ⟦E30⟧.
rows.quest:8995:details:1: When alive, ⟦E25⟧ used to inhabit what is now The Beast's chamber. Go there and use the ⟦E20⟧ to summon forth ⟦E25⟧. It will reincorporate him, so he'll have to be killed again. I'd take care of The Beast first, and be sure take enough friends along to survive the upper portion of ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:8995:details:2: Once you've dispatched Valthalak, use the amulet on his corpse. With his spirit reunified, he'll likely want his amulet back, as well.
rows.quest:8995:completion:0: How fortunate for you that I know you're not part of the original group that stole this from me.
rows.quest:8995:completion:1: I'll take back what is mine now, mortal! Give the amulet to me!

quest:8995.turner: Spirit of Lord Valthalak («روح لرد والثالاک»)
